OTECH 10G SFP+ Case OT-SFC10GE Fiber Media Converter

The OTECH 10G SFP+ Case OT-SFC10GE Fiber Media Converter is a high-performance networking device designed to provide seamless and reliable fiber-to-Ethernet conversion. Built for high-speed data transmission, this media converter supports a transmission rate of 8.5Gbps to 11.7Gbps, making it an ideal solution for data centers, enterprise networks, and telecom applications. Equipped with an SFP+ standard slot, the OT-SFC10GE offers flexible connectivity options, allowing users to integrate various SFP+ modules based on their specific networking requirements. Whether you need to extend network coverage over long distances or connect different media types, this converter provides a robust and adaptable solution. One of its key advantages is low power consumption, operating at just ≤4W, which helps reduce energy costs and ensures efficient performance. The device is powered by a DC 12V input voltage, and an AC adapter is included in the set, making installation simple and convenient. Designed for stable operation in diverse environments, the OT-SFC10GE supports an operating temperature range of 0°C to 60°C, ensuring durability and reliability under various conditions. With a compact size of 110mm (L) × 100mm (W) × 30mm (H), it is easy to integrate into existing network setups without taking up much space. Ideal for high-speed networking applications, the OTECH 10G SFP+ Case OT-SFC10GE Fiber Media Converter delivers excellent performance, flexibility, and energy efficiency. Whether used for expanding fiber networks, enhancing data transmission, or improving overall connectivity, this media converter is a cost-effective and powerful networking solution.

Features of OTECH 10G SFP+ Case OT-SFC10GE Fiber Media Converter

  • High-Speed Transmission – Supports a transmission rate of 8.5Gbps to 11.7Gbps, ensuring fast and stable data transfer.
  • SFP+ Standard Slot – Equipped with an SFP+ interface, allowing flexible connectivity with various SFP+ modules.
  • Low Power Consumption – Operates at ≤4W, ensuring energy efficiency and cost-effective performance.
  • Reliable Power Supply – Uses a DC 12V input voltage, with an AC adapter included for easy installation.
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range – Functions efficiently in temperatures ranging from 0°C to 60°C, ensuring stability in different environments.
  • Compact and Space-Saving Design – Small 110mm (L) × 100mm (W) × 30mm (H) form factor for easy integration into existing network setups.
  • Seamless Fiber-to-Ethernet Conversion – Provides high-performance fiber-to-Ethernet connectivity for data centers, enterprises, and telecom applications.
  • Enhanced Network Expansion – Ideal for extending network coverage and improving data transmission efficiency.
  • Plug-and-Play Installation – Simple setup with minimal configuration required, making it user-friendly.
  • Versatile Application – Suitable for enterprise networks, data centers, and high-speed connectivity solutions.
